title: THE HALLOWEEN ISSUE · The sign spells
venue: the Timberline · an unpublished Halloween issue · Box 1
logline: The Lanes' sign, every letter lit, and on Halloween night some letters go out and come back in an order: the strip draws four states of the sign, and the reader can read the dark letters as a word, and the strip won't. Gully reads it aloud in the last panel and the balloon is blank.
